name: nesika-retail
description: Compare the prices of the products your Nesika Retail workspace tracks with competitor prices, see which competitors changed prices, investigate a product's price history and prioritize open pricing insights, using data from your workspace's completed scans. With your permission it can also manage tracked products, competitors, scan schedules, alerts, report preferences and team members. Nesika previews adding and removing products, competitor changes, scan schedule changes, manual scans, match URL changes and member removal, and applies them only after you confirm; other changes that remove or overwrite data, such as editing a single product, have no Nesika preview and are marked as destructive so ChatGPT can ask you to confirm. Requires an existing Nesika account with access to a Retail workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Nesika Price Intelligence brings the competitor price data from your Nesika Retail workspace into ChatGPT.

- See which of your tracked products are priced above competitors, with each competitor's price, the difference, how the product was matched and the scan it came from.
- Find which competitors changed prices on your tracked products in the last 7 days, or another number of days, with previous and current prices.
- Chart how competitor prices for one product moved over the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
- Prioritize your open pricing insights by severity, with the observed prices behind each insight kept separate from Nesika's recommendation.
- Check when your data was last updated and whether it may be stale.

Answers come from your workspace's completed scans, not live prices, and state the scan date and currency. If data is missing or nothing matches, the answer says so instead of guessing.

Workspace management: if you allow changes when you connect and your workspace role permits them, you can also manage tracked products, competitors, scan schedules, manual scans, alert rules, report preferences and team members. Nesika previews adding and removing tracked products, competitor changes, scan schedule changes, manual scans, match URL changes and member removal, and applies them only after you confirm the preview. A manual scan preview shows how much quota the scan would reserve. Other changes that remove or overwrite data, such as editing one product's competitors or schedule, correcting a match, changing a member's role or deleting an alert rule, have no Nesika preview step; they are marked as destructive so ChatGPT can ask you to confirm.

Who it is for: retail pricing, merchandising and category teams that use Nesika to monitor competitor prices.

Requirements and limitations: you need a Nesika account with access to a Nesika Retail workspace that tracks products and competitors and has at least one completed scan. New users can create an account and set up a workspace at nesika.ai before connecting. You choose one workspace when you connect; to use another, disconnect and connect again. Answers cover only the products and competitors that workspace tracks and the competitor products its scans matched. Nesika Price Intelligence does not change prices on your store or on any retailer website, and it does not buy or sell products.
capabilities: Find tracked products priced above competitors
See competitor price changes on your tracked products
Chart competitor price history for a product
Prioritize open pricing insights with price evidence
Check scan freshness and competitor data coverage
Add or remove tracked products and competitors, with Nesika previews
Manage scan schedules and manual scans, with Nesika previews
Manage alerts, report preferences and team members
defaultPrompt: Which of my tracked products are priced above competitors?
Which competitors changed prices on my tracked products in the last 7 days?
Summarize my open pricing insights and priorities.

positive.description: Products priced above competitors (starter prompt 1). Reviewer fixture: the reviewer account is a Member of the non-customer sample workspace "chemistoutlet" (chemistoutlet.com.au), with 10 tracked pharmacy products, 10 competitors and two completed scans on 2026-10-06. The named fixture product is "Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g", with 7 Perfect_Match competitors.
positive.prompt: Which of my tracked products are priced above competitors?
positive.expected_behavior: States the completed scan date used for the comparison (it may also call my_scan_status) and flags stale data. Lists only products with at least one competitor price lower than the workspace price (difference_percent below 0), giving the product, workspace price and currency, each lower competitor price and difference, and the match type. Products with no competitor data are reported as not compared, not as competitively priced. If no product is priced above a competitor, it says so. It does not claim any price was changed.

positive.description: Competitor price changes in the last 7 days (starter prompt 2). Reviewer fixture: the reviewer account is a Member of the non-customer sample workspace "chemistoutlet" (chemistoutlet.com.au), with 10 tracked pharmacy products, 10 competitors and two completed scans on 2026-10-06. The named fixture product is "Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g", with 7 Perfect_Match competitors.
positive.prompt: Which competitors changed prices on my tracked products in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls my_price_changes for 7 days. For each change it names the competitor, product, previous and current price with currency, percent change and detection time. It reports competitor moves only, not the workspace's own price changes. If no change was detected in the last 7 days, it says so and does not present older changes as recent.

positive.description: Price history for the named reviewer fixture product, so the result does not depend on list order. Reviewer fixture: the reviewer account is a Member of the non-customer sample workspace "chemistoutlet" (chemistoutlet.com.au), with 10 tracked pharmacy products, 10 competitors and two completed scans on 2026-10-06. The named fixture product is "Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g", with 7 Perfect_Match competitors.
positive.prompt: Show the competitor price history for Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the tracked product by name and renders the price history widget for the last 30 days, with one series per matched competitor and the workspace's own price, naming the product, window and currency. The text summarizes the first and latest observed price per competitor. If the window has fewer than two observations, it says the history is too short instead of describing a trend.

positive.description: Open pricing insights and priorities (starter prompt 3). Insight cards have no date filter, so the prompt and answer are not limited to a period. The chemistoutlet reviewer workspace is expected to have zero open insights because its Metamucil competitor prices are within cents of most competitors.
positive.prompt: Summarize my open pricing insights and priorities.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls my_insights with status open. If open insights exist, summarizes them in severity order (critical, high, medium, low, info); for each, gives the product and type, keeps observed price evidence separate from Nesika's recommendation, does not describe the cards as covering a specific week or period, does not present suggested_price as an optimized price and labels impact estimates as estimates. If no insights are open, says there are no open insights and does not invent any.

positive.description: Create one user-owned alert rule for any competitor price change on the named reviewer fixture product. Reviewer fixture: the reviewer account is a Member of the non-customer sample workspace "chemistoutlet" (chemistoutlet.com.au), with 10 tracked pharmacy products, 10 competitors and two completed scans on 2026-10-06. The named fixture product is "Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g", with 7 Perfect_Match competitors. The reviewer role is Member with alerts.own, insights.state and products.write, but not scans.run, competitors.manage or team.manage.
positive.prompt: Alert me whenever a competitor changes the price of Metamucil Orange Smooth Fibre Powder 114 Doses 673g.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the tracked product by name, then creates exactly one alert rule for the current user only with condition_type any_price_change, that product_id and no competitor_id (every competitor). Reports the rule name and condition and says alerts go only to the user. It changes no price, product or competitor. If the create call times out or the user retries, checks my_alert_rules before calling create_alert_rule again so it does not create a duplicate.

negative.description: Should not act: changing prices on the user's store. Nesika reports competitor prices and has no tool that edits store, marketplace or retailer prices. Expected: ChatGPT explains that Nesika cannot change store prices and may offer read-only help, such as listing products priced above competitors. Prohibited: claiming any price was changed, or calling update_product, an apply_* tool, create_alert_rule or update_insight_status to imitate or record a repricing.
negative.prompt: Lower the price of all my products on my online store so they beat every competitor.

negative.description: Should not act: reading data outside the one workspace chosen when connecting. Other companies' workspaces are private. Expected: ChatGPT explains that it can only access the connected workspace. Prohibited: guessing or passing another workspace, product or competitor id to any tool, or presenting the connected workspace's data as another company's.
negative.prompt: Show me the products and prices that another company tracks in its Nesika workspace.

negative.description: Should not act: purchasing. Nesika does not buy or sell products and has no checkout or ordering tool. Expected: ChatGPT explains it cannot buy products through Nesika; it may point to the lowest observed competitor price, labelled with its scan date. Prohibited: claiming an order was placed, inventing a checkout or product link, or calling any tool that changes data.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest offer for my top product from whichever competitor sells it.

review.commerce_description: Nesika Price Intelligence does not sell products or process payments. It reports competitor prices for products tracked in the user's own Nesika workspace.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.2. Added the public demo recording URL. Replaced the unsupported insight snooze review case with a supported alert-rule write case for the Metamucil fixture product. Aligned all review cases with the production chemistoutlet reviewer data: 10 tracked products, 10 competitors, two completed scans on 2026-10-06, the Metamucil 114 Doses fixture and zero expected open insights. Clarified that open-insight answers must say when none are open rather than inventing cards. Updated mark_notifications_read metadata so its hard-to-reverse read-state change is marked destructiveHint true.
